text: Provides a documented REST API using JSON and OAuth token authentication for managing scheduling data
quote: The SavvyCal API adheres to REST conventions. Our API communicates in JSON format and uses OAuth access tokens to authenticate requests.

text: JavaScript embed library lets you place scheduling links inline, as a popover, or via floating widget/hyperlink trigger
quote: Let visitors schedule time without ever leaving your website. Trigger your embedded link via hyperlink, the floating button, or a JavaScript call.

text: Webhooks notify external systems via HTTP POST when account/booking events occur
quote: Webhooks allow you to listen for changes in a SavvyCal account and get notified via HTTP POST requests.

text: Webhook payloads are signed with a SHA-256 HMAC signature for verification
quote: SavvyCal signs the request body with a SHA-256 HMAC signature. The signature is included in the x-savvycal-signature header.

text: Supports OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow and personal access token authentication for API access
quote: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow ... Personal access token authentication

text: Collective availability shows slots only when every required team member is free
quote: Show collective availability to book any available team member.

text: Automatically distributes meetings across team members fairly (round robin)
quote: Automatically distribute meetings across team members fairly.

text: Team availability can include external (non-native) calendars when checking who's free
quote: Include external calendars when showing team availability.

text: Connects to Stripe to require payment before a booking is confirmed
quote: Connect your link to a corresponding product in your Stripe account and require payment before reserving the meeting time.

text: Automatically calculates and collects sales tax, VAT, and GST via Stripe Tax
quote: Calculate and collect sales tax, VAT, and GST with the click of a button (powered by Stripe Tax).

text: Lets you cap the number of meetings allowed per day, week, and month
quote: Limit how many meetings are allowed on a per-day, week, and month basis.

text: Lets you budget time using calendar events so SavvyCal honors those time-protection preferences
quote: Budget your time using calendar events, and wire up SavvyCal to honor those preferences.

text: Encourages recipients to book meetings near existing ones to reduce calendar fragmentation
quote: Encourage people to schedule meetings near other meetings, to prevent calendar fragmentation.

text: Lets invitees vote on which proposed times work best for a group
quote: Invite people to vote on times that work best for them. Available for free, no annoying ads.

text: Workflows let you send customized meeting lifecycle messages and automate manual tasks
quote: It’s never been easier to send customized meeting lifecycle messages and automate manual tasks with SavvyCal workflows.

text: Workflows can be attached to one or more scheduling links to avoid repetitive setup
quote: Attach workflows to one or more links to save yourself from repetitive work.

text: Zapier integration triggers no-code automations like CRM sync, reminders, and task creation
quote: Trigger no-code automations with Zapier ... Sync with your CRM, send yourself reminders, create project management to-do’s…the sky’s the limit.

text: Combined team availability automatically routes each booked meeting to the correct person
quote: Show combined availability for your whole team and automatically route each booked meeting to the right person.

text: Round robin links can randomly select or cycle through team members for distribution
quote: The choice is yours — randomly select who the meeting gets booked with for maximum availability or cycle through team members for equal distribution.

text: Team members can set custom availability per round-robin link or default to their normal hours
quote: Team members can set custom availability for each round robin scheduling link or default to their preset work hours.

text: Automatically creates video conferencing links (Zoom rooms, Google Meet, Whereby) for booked events
quote: Automatically create unique Zoom rooms for new events.

text: Recipients can overlay their own calendar on top of the booking link to spot mutual availability
quote: Allow recipients to overlay their calendar on top of yours to easily find mutual availability.

text: Generates a shareable text snippet proposing times so recipients can pick a slot in two clicks
quote: Generate a snippet of text to propose times in just seconds. Recipients can pick a time to meet in just two clicks.

text: Prices and offerings (products) can be managed natively inside SavvyCal without visiting Stripe
quote: You don’t even have to leave SavvyCal to create new offerings or adjust your prices. Do it all natively within SavvyCal.

text: Presents ranked availability windows to nudge recipients toward the optimal time while staying flexible
quote: Present ranked availability windows to encourage recipients to pick the optimal time (while still remaining flexible).

text: Links can be styled with custom colors, banner image, and avatar for brand matching
quote: Adjust the colors, banner image, and avatar that appear on your links to match your unique style.

text: Scheduling links can be hosted on your own custom domain for a white-labeled booking experience
quote: Host your scheduling links on your own custom domain, for a professional white-labeled booking experience.

text: Group event links allow multiple schedulers to join the same time slot (e.g. webinars, group coaching)
quote: Allow multiple schedulers to join the same time slot. Perfect for webinars and group coaching calls.

text: Reminder timing and content can be customized (or use templates) to reduce no-shows
quote: Customize your timing and content to minimize no-shows. Compose from scratch or pick one of our handy templates.

text: Webhooks can be configured through Settings > Integrations in the dashboard
quote: Navigate to Settings > Integrations and click the + icon in the Webhooks
